/usr/bin/cmake -E rm -f CMakeFiles/ClipHub.dir/objects.a
/usr/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-ar qc CMakeFiles/ClipHub.dir/objects.a @CMakeFiles/ClipHub.dir/objects1
/usr/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++-posix -O3 -DNDEBUG -mwindows -static -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++ -Wl,--whole-archive CMakeFiles/ClipHub.dir/objects.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive -o ClipHub.exe -Wl,--out-implib,libClipHub.dll.a -Wl,--major-image-version,0,--minor-image-version,0 @CMakeFiles/ClipHub.dir/linkLibs.rsp
